actions.text: Review session: pulled live worker bundles, diffed them against the repo, queried D1, read trenches-hq. Wrote docs/reviews/2026-10-22-operating-review.md.
Published this page and created the daily Business Partner routine (6:36 CT).
Wrote the orchestrator guard, scorer fix and GitHub Actions runner as a patch set for trenches-hq. Nothing deployed.
Closed 75 queued candidates on dead campaigns and cancelled 3 failed demo jobs in D1. Four more cleanup updates were blocked by the permission guard.

Pushed trenches-hq branch claude/orchestrator-guard-scorer-fix (700acb4): runner guard, Actions prospector runner, upload hardening, demo quote escaping, checkout GET to POST, Stripe signature age check. Checks pass. Not deployed.
Read all 45 Claude sessions back to Aug 30 and the Oct 19 runs of the Marketplace Monitor and Books refresh. Both routines stop on purpose and say why.
Created the weekly Trenches Self Evaluation task (Sunday 6:36 PM CT). Recorded the Smartlead decision. Added a GitHub Actions deploy workflow to trenches-hq.
Merged PR #15 and #16 in trenches-hq. Deployed trenches-os-api (06f3b688) and trenches-site from GitHub Actions. Verified both live bundles. Synced them into Trenches-Group.
Queued 347 HUMAN_REVIEW leads for requalification through deferred_events. Retired the desktop deploy path in trenches-hq (branch claude/retire-desktop-deploy).
Requalification done: 347 scored, 0 newly qualified, 5 disqualified, 342 back to review with fresh reasons. Deployed trenches-os-api again (02:23 UTC, includes PR 17).

Daily run 1: gathered D1, routines, Hyperagent, Gmail. No client or prospect replies in 7 days. Left 2 follow-up drafts (Get Lit Q-1004, Benson Q-1005 and Q-1006). Saved a 7-row Murfreesboro tree-service shortlist to Drive (directory sites unreachable from the cloud). Did not flip PROSPECTOR_ORCHESTRATOR_ENABLED: the deployed runner guard makes that rule unnecessary. Brief emailed.

Daily run 2: gathered D1, routines, GitHub Actions, Gmail, Hyperagent. Found the Prospector runner workflow failing hourly (secret empty) and PR #20 (Door Crew) merged but not deployed. No client or prospect replies in 7 days; both Oct 22 drafts still unsent. Saved a 12-row Murfreesboro roofing shortlist to Drive (snippet-verified only). Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 3: D1 unreadable (Cloudflare connector lost authorization). Read three successful Prospector runner logs: the runner is alive since Oct 23 23:10 UTC, Electrical and Fencing Murfreesboro worked, at least 7 leads saved. Weekly Insights ran Fri and emailed. No client or prospect replies in 7 days; both Oct 22 drafts still unsent. Saved an 11-row Murfreesboro HVAC shortlist to Drive (not deduped). Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 4: D1 unreadable for the second day. Prospector runner: 10 green windows since Oct 23, now on Smyrna campaigns; discovery tail is all duplicates. No client or prospect replies in 7 days; both Oct 22 drafts still unsent (72 h). Lightscout: 0 emails found, about 28 pending. Saved a 12-row Murfreesboro plumbing shortlist to Drive (not deduped, campaign unconfirmed). Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed. Self Evaluation fires tonight.

Weekly self evaluation: read both repos, 47 sessions, all routine runs, 22 runner runs and four days of dashboard history. Wrote docs/reviews/2026-10-25-weekly.md. Verdict: pipeline alive, partner blind two days, one of five asks cleared, Fenlo live code not on main, runner discovery loop wasteful. Dashboard refreshed, review emailed.

Daily run 5: D1 unreadable (day 3). Found the Prospector runner out of Anthropic API credit in run 24 while GitHub shows green; the orchestrator is creating new campaigns (Pest Control Eagleville). No social draft from the first unattended vivid-weekly-social-batch run. No client or prospect replies; both Oct 22 drafts still unsent. No cloud batch (no campaign can be chosen without D1). Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 6: D1 unreadable (day 4), confirmed account-wide by the Monday Brief session. Runner credit restored (run 29 saved JB Tree Service). ODS (Skyler McLain) replied Oct 26; reply drafted in Gmail. Lightscout found 18 emails, 46 pending upload. Marketplace Monitor and Books stopped again. No cloud batch. Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 7: D1 unreadable (day 5). Read PR #22 (outreach restart, hot lead alerts, continuous prospector; merge-ready, needs the secret, merge, two deploys and four flags from Connor) and PR #21 (Vivid Light Show, deployed 02:26 UTC). Runner 24 green windows. Lightscout found nothing. No client mail; three drafts unsent. No cloud batch. Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 8: D1 unreadable (day 6). Connor sent the ODS reply and the Benson follow-up at 05:23 CT; Get Lit draft remains. PR #22 reworked to a two-step soft opener (5 commits). Two new Claude app routines (Morning brief, Heartbeat) created today. Runner 28 green windows. Lightscout 1 email, 47 pending. No cloud batch. Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

Daily run 9: D1 unreadable (day 7). Runner API credit out again from 01:52 UTC (runs 40 and 41 green but every call failed). PR #22 unchanged. Lightscout 0 leads, no browser tool two nights running. Get Lit draft still unsent, no replies from ODS or Benson. No cloud batch. Dashboard refreshed, brief emailed.

decisions: Top up the API credit now and set auto-reload?
Reauthorize the Cloudflare and Stripe connectors now?
Merge and deploy PR #22 this week, and flip outreach on with the cap of 50?
